AfterSideTurnEnd.rationale: CORRECT SLOT. Like NoBlockPower, DiamondDiademPower.cs:34-40 has no participants filter -- it Removes whenever side == CombatSide.Enemy -- so the sim's side-scoped on_enemy_side_end (combat.py:345, the Hook.AfterTurnEnd(Enemy) slot at CombatManager.cs:1256) is exactly right and there is no per-creature question to lose. The sim's _expire (powers.py:86-92) pops the power and unregisters it; C#'s PowerCmd.Remove (PowerCmd.cs:287-295) additionally fires power.AfterRemoved, which this power does not implement. Observationally identical, same treatment as the _expire entries in audit/records/power/duplication.json and audit/records/power/flame_barrier.json per binding rule 3.

guards.what: The applier's own condition (DiamondDiadem.cs) -- BLOCKED ON THE RELIC TIER
guards.issue: RE-VERDICTED 2026-07-26 (review fix pass): `waiver` -> `gap`. The old rationale delegated the applier's condition to `audit/records/relic/diamond_diadem`, WHICH DOES NOT EXIST -- the relic tier is 0 of 258 audited -- so under binding rule 4 (a guard carries max(verdict) of what it aggregates) it was waiving an unaudited verdict, and `waiver` is reserved for genuinely out-of-scope material in any case. Re-verdicted on this record's own evidence, because whether the applier fires when the game's does IS this power's reachability. C# (DiamondDiadem.cs) does three things: counts plays in AfterCardPlayed behind `cardPlay.Card.Owner == base.Owner` and `CombatManager.Instance.IsInProgress` (:43-56); grants the power from BeforeSideTurnEnd when `CardsPlayedThisTurn <= CardThreshold` (2) and then zeroes the counter (:58-70); and **zeroes the counter again in AfterCombatEnd (:78-84)**. The sim's relic (relics/diamond_diadem.py:28-39) reproduces the first two -- `on_player_turn_end` IS the Hook.BeforeSideTurnEnd slot (combat.py:654; same finding as this stream's power/the_bomb BeforeSideTurnEnd entry), the threshold is 2 and the turn-end reset is there -- but it has NO combat-end reset. **EXECUTED 2026-07-26:** play two harmless cards, then kill the last enemy with a third. The combat ends inside play_card (combat.py:417-418), so `on_player_turn_end` never runs and the relic instance keeps `cards_played_this_turn == 3`; carried into the next combat, turn 1 of that fight grants NO Diamond Diadem power (3 > 2) where the game grants it, because AfterCombatEnd had reset the counter. So the POWER silently fails to appear for a turn of a later fight -- reachability, which is exactly what this guard is for. OWNERSHIP: the FIX belongs to the relic tier (`audit/records/relic/diamond_diadem`, unwritten), so this entry is the explicit blocked-on-relic-tier marker and cannot be closed from here. Seen and NOT part of the gap: `cardPlay.Card.Owner != base.Owner` is the multiplayer card-owner test, and ShowCounter / DisplayAmount / RefreshCounter / Status are presentation. Third-file citations, not hashed here.
